'''Off-Worlders' Quarter''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ropagi II]]. Technically not a quarter, but a city on its own, it was located in a large natural bay on the continent of [[Forethought]]. All off-worlders had to report here before being cleared to the rest of the planet. The famous mercenary markets were also located here, as well as a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]], [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]]. Districts in the Quarter included the [[Off-Worlders' Quarter Starport]], [[Prosperity Row]], [[the River]], [[the Black Hole]], and [[the Scrap Heap]].
